title: Document Rebuild Welcome V1
description: Which hub `Welcome` completes a document rebuild (a rebootstrap after a remote fold over pending local operations, or a hub `RebootstrapRequired`). The hub serves a canonical checkpoint pair only over its `active-checkpoint/pair` route and answers every hello with `None` or a `Tail`, so an actor-bound document is rebuilt like a first open: the `Welcome` tail is accepted and the new actor child is seeded from the pair route once the `Session` admits it. A document not run by a browser actor still needs the pair inside the `Welcome` and refuses a bare tail. A rebuild's own socket close reconnects at once, never with an outage's backoff.

lane.description: `browser-actor`: the document's live lease runs it in a verified browser actor.

accepted.description: The rebuild continues on this socket (no close, no bootstrap failure).
